alerts.headline: I-95 Northbound Major Construction & Single Lane Closure
alerts.description: Bridge deck resurfacing near Exit 16. Expect 25-35 minute delays during peak travel hours. Alternate routes via Parkway advised.

alerts.headline: Regional Wind Advisory in Effect
alerts.description: Sustained winds 25 to 30 mph with localized gusts up to 45 mph possible this evening. High-profile vehicles use caution.

alerts.headline: Downtown Crosstown Utility Work
alerts.description: Right lane closed between 4th Ave and 8th Ave for fiber conduit repairs. Traffic flowing smoothly with slight slow-downs.
